blocks.text: The slope of cut surfaces shall be no steeper than is safe for the intended use and shall be no steeper than three horizontal to one vertical unless approved by the Department of Public Works. (Ord. 16432 § 6(3), 3-10-92. Code 1995 § 66-123.)
